summary: Speed up the scenario kit's deterministic rebase property tests

replay.detail: No deployed replay or runtime data change.

compatibility.detail: Test-only change: cache anchor instant values, compare structured slices without JSON round trips, and replace 100 equivalent valid-shift draws with 32 fixed-seed draws plus eight explicit calendar boundaries. Every ordinary world and slice is still checked at every clock; runtime APIs and emitted files are unchanged.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
